title: State Council Advice on Consumer Rights

content.scenario: The State Council of Maharashtra receives a complaint from a consumer regarding a defective product sold by a local retailer. The consumer seeks advice on how to proceed with the complaint.
content.outcome: The State Council shall render advice to the consumer on the promotion and protection of their rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, within the state of Maharashtra.

user_queries: What is the role of the State Council in consumer protection?
How can I get advice on consumer rights in Maharashtra?
What are the responsibilities of the State Council under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019?
